scope: raised itchy welts without any airway, tongue, throat, faintness, or systemic symptoms; must actively confirm the absence of those symptoms
patterns: I suddenly have itchy raised welts
what can I do for mild hives
rash that moves around and itches
response: First check for any serious allergic signs: trouble breathing or swallowing, tightness in the throat, swelling of the lips, tongue, or mouth, dizziness, faintness, confusion, or repeated vomiting. If any of these are present, call local emergency services now and use a prescribed epinephrine auto-injector if the person has one, following its instructions. If symptoms are only on the skin and the person is otherwise well, avoid the suspected trigger and speak to a pharmacist or clinician for individualized advice.
red_flags: trouble breathing, wheezing, or a hoarse voice
swelling of the lips, tongue, mouth, or throat
widespread rapidly worsening rash with feeling unwell
known severe allergy or previous anaphylaxis
